card.title: USB to FPC adapter to test the Controller board(s)

source.title: USB to FPC adapter to test the Controller board(s)

claims.statement: Steam Deck controller boards can be bench-tested on a PC via a USB-to-FPC adapter (8-pin 0.5 mm FPC test board): pin 1 or 2 = +5 V, pins 3/6/7 = GND, pin 4 = D-, pin 5 = D+.
A good board shows up in lsusb and as 'Steam Deck Controller' in Steam; with touchpads/sticks unplugged the cursor may drift because it falls back to mouse mode.

procedure: Build adapter; verify +5 V lands on FPC pin 1/2 before connecting a board.
Connect the controller board; confirm ground.
Plug into PC; check lsusb and Steam controller test.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Putting +5 V on a data or key pin can fry the controller board.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
